changes.new: IWorkSourceDocument.Open(path | stream, IWorkDocumentKind.Pages, readOptions[, ct]).ToWord(...) / ToWordResult(...)
changes.reason: Converters use the shared shape: To{Target}(options[, out OfficeConversionReport], ct), To{Target}Async returning OfficeConversionResult<T>, and SaveAs{Target}(path | stream) returning OfficeConversionReport. Result, Bytes and Stream twins are removed.
changes.replacement: Open the source with IWorkSourceDocument.Open and call ToWord, SaveAsWord or ToWordResult; append RequireCompleteEditableReconstruction() to keep the strict behaviour.

changes.new: IWorkSourceDocument.ToWord(PagesWordExportOptions options[, out OfficeConversionReport report], CancellationToken); ToWordAsync; SaveAsWord(path | stream); SaveAsWordAsync
changes.reason: Converters use the shared shape: To{Target}(options[, out OfficeConversionReport], ct), To{Target}Async returning OfficeConversionResult<T>, and SaveAs{Target}(path | stream) returning OfficeConversionReport. Result, Bytes and Stream twins are removed.
changes.replacement: ToWord returns partial reconstructions with their report; use ToWordResult(...).RequireCompleteEditableReconstruction() for the previous strict behaviour.

changes.new: IWorkSourceDocument.ToWordResult(IWorkConversionOptions options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) : PagesToWordResult
changes.reason: The result keeps the source package and the typed source projection, which the common report does not carry, so it stays as a distinct evidence operation.
